ios.desc:
Talk seamlessly with today’s best AI models in one place: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Grok, Mistral, and more. Leverage powerful features like shared memory, multi-angle reasoning, capturing insights, creating notes, branching and more.

SWITCH BETWEEN THE BEST MODELS INSTANTLY

Compare perspectives across leading AI models. Start with a model and switch to another mid-conversation. Re-generate replies with different models, switch versions and compare. 

A MEMORY LAYER THAT WORKS ACROSS CHATS

Toggle on the memory layer to let Asterode remember what matters and reuse it when needed, across any model and chat.

SAVE, EDIT AND REUSE IMPORTANT INSIGHTS

Turn key replies into a personal, organized library for quick access that you can drop back into new conversations as rich context.

CREATE NOTES FROM SCRATCH AND USE THEM LATER

Capture your thoughts with rich text notes. Use them later in chats.

WORK WITH FILES EFFORTLESSLY

Upload images and PDFs for analysis, summaries, corrections, explanations, or extraction.

BRANCH YOUR THINKING

Create version-aware forks to explore alternate paths, different tones, or better solutions. Push your thoughts further while keeping your previous threads intact as ideas grow.

PERSONALIZATION

Choose tone, detail, readability, creativity, emoji use, and output format so replies match more accurately with your expectations.

INCOGNITO MODE

Enable Incognito Mode for temporary conversations that are excluded from your chats list, memory, training, and history.

BUILT-IN WEB SEARCH

Pull in fresh information directly inside any model when you need current data or verification.

USAGE TRACKING

See your daily and monthly limits across Standard and Premium messages.

---

Whether you’re researching, planning, building, writing, or solving hard problems, Asterode helps you achieve better results much faster.

One app. One subscription. Powerful features and every major AI model at your fingertips.

---

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/


Privacy Policy: https://asterode.ai/app-privacy

quotes.text:
Hey!

I’m Stef, and I built Asterode.

In 2025 I got pulled into development through “vibe coding.” I don’t come from a technical background, but I wanted to build things. I started with small, fun experiments, then decided to go the learn-by-doing route and build something serious.

I picked one of the most practical ideas on my list: a single app that solves a daily pain point and would make my future building faster.

I brainstorm a lot with AI, and I found I get the best results when I combine perspectives from different AI models. But switching providers to do that was a mess. Constantly moving context and replies back and forth was counter-productive. Doing it on mobile was even worse.

So I built Asterode: one app, every model, context across everything, in my pocket.

Compare perspectives (switch mid-conversation, re-generated with different models), branch explorations, capture key insights, build on memory or on custom

At some point I thought: why not polish it and ship it? The scope jumped fast (server-side, subscriptions, usage limits, billing, privacy/data controls…), but shipping it made me even more technical.

This is my first app and it was completely vibe coded.

Happy to answer questions and would genuinely love honest feedback.

iOS: ‎https://apps.apple.com/us/app/asterode/id6758882535

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.asterode.app
